description: A chromatic tuner that reads either a signal or a pitch voltage, showing the note on a needle display and putting the detected frequency out as a voltage

params.text: Shifts the voltage being measured by up to two octaves either way
Sets the frequency the tuner takes as A, which every reading is measured against
Names the notes do, re and mi rather than A, B and C
Reads low pitches accurately, from 8Hz to about 1100Hz

inputs.text: The signal whose pitch is measured; while something is patched here it is read in place of anything at the voltage input
A pitch voltage to be measured, turned into a frequency inside the module and shifted by the OCTAVE knob

outputs.text: A copy of the voltage at the voltage input, for passing it on
A copy of the signal at the signal input, for passing it on
A pitch voltage worked out from the detected frequency, tuned to track the Fundamental oscillators in unison

notes: the display gives the note being targeted as a MIDI note tag with the deviation in cents, and turns green within 4% of that note and red within 0.5% of it
